summary.name: Cutout Animation, category Animation Techniques. The label was normalized from source descriptions. The method may be photographed or digitally simulated, and the source video's actual technique is not verified.
summary.visualIdentity: Photographic cutouts, paper, drawn objects, and lettering are layered around one shared theme. Cut edges, slight paper thickness, and consistent contact shadows define the look. Pivots and occlusion are set before motion, and joint gaps, intersections, and conflicting shadows are avoided.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: the file says to use this style alone when photos and drawn pieces already share a theme, and it names hybrids for headlines and limited parallax. Inferred: themed explainers, editorial collage shorts, and scene openers or transitions. No verified use cases are listed.
summary.limitations: Visual cues are user-requested guidance, not verified against a source video. Procedural paper curl is an artistic bend, not a physical paper solver. Flat scenes should stay flat SVG or Canvas rather than 3D. Rough.js adds no real paper texture, poses, or handwriting. Simulated appearance is not evidence of physical photography.
summary.palette: Optional fallback tokens: background #F0E5D0 for neutral paper, foreground #3B3C34 for text, and accent_1 #987A5C for decoration. Gradients are disabled, and colors stay discrete. Apply them only to new presentation elements; source cutouts keep their colors, and task or reference colors override these. Foreground on background measures 8.94:1 and meets normal text. Accent on background measures 3.19:1, so it is decorative only. These are two-color checks, so verify composited frames.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit motion vocabulary: placing, peeling, hinged movement, pose replacement, and limited parallax. Held poses or continuous keyframes are both allowed. A 12 fps art cadence may repeat within a higher-frame-rate output, but stop-motion stepping is not required by the name. Video motion derives from seekable composition time with one owner per property. Interactive parallax should be capped and disabled for reduced motion. Optional references: motion-037 for pivoted cut-letter exits and motion-038 for punctuation occlusion, each only when scene assets support the action.
summary.audio: The file gives no style-specific audio requirement; its audio direction is generic and optional. Options include background music, voiceover, sung vocals, sound effects, ambience, or silence. Inferred fit: restrained paper-sound accents or light music that leaves room for narration and reading holds. No fixed genre or tempo is prescribed. Honor supplied audio. Use music-timed cuts only after audio analysis, and check speech intelligibility and clipping.
summary.assetRequirements: Required inputs are photographic cutouts, paper and drawn pieces, lettering, and any approved exact copy; the file supplies none of these. Prepare transparent masks, cut edges, and pivot-organized layers before animation. Load local fonts and assets first. Preserve source artwork and exact colors without recoloring. Report missing assets rather than inventing copy or a brand mark. Seed any generated paper grain or sketch geometry so renders are repeatable.
summary.combinations: Style-054 (photocopy grain and cut lettering) can supply headline treatment for new type only; keep its grain fixed and omit its red accent. Style-101 (limited parallax) can place foreground, mid, and back paper layers with small offsets; shadows must shift consistently with depth, and pivots stay unchanged. Each combination must keep source cutout colors unchanged.
summary.productionApproach: HyperFrames is the default pipeline for composition timing, audio synchronization, validation, and export. Remotion is a fallback only when a verified limitation applies, and that reason must be recorded. Pillow, or Sharp in Node.js, prepares masks and transparent crops. PixiJS suits large sprite or sticker sets, and Rough.js applies only to explicitly sketch-like marks. GSAP owns the paused, seekable timeline, and procedural paper curl is optional for bent corners.
